answer_1.outputs: translated English sentences with recovered zero pronouns

answer_2.quote: We used case-insensitive tokenBLEU to measure the overall translation quality of translation systems... To measure the performance of ZPT, we used a variant of APT... Specifically, the variant AZPT evaluates the accuracy of translating zero pronouns...

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly select a hundred groups of samples from each domain... we asked expert raters to score all of these samples in 1 to 5 scores to reflect the quality of ZP translations.
answer_4.guideline: Ratings based on five error categories: 1) semantic loss and structural issues; 2) semantic loss without structural issues; 3) structural issues without semantic loss; 4) ZP error but meaning preserved; 5) correct translation.
